description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Generalized CLASS of the P304 centrifuge M-03 miss: a contract caches an EIP-712 DOMAIN_SEPARATOR at construction computed from `name`/`version`, but `name`/`version` is mutable post-construction (set via a setter / `file('name')`, or never set in the constructor at all). The cached separator then does not match the live name -> permit/EIP-712 signatures fail to verify. Two-signal AND: S1 a cached domain separator computed in the constructor from name/version; S2 name/version mutable post-construction. Suppress: name+version set in ctor with no setter; pure libs. Anchor: centrifuge token/ERC20.sol caches immutable _DOMAIN_SEPARATOR in the ctor via _calculateDomainSeparator (keccak256(bytes(name))) while `name` is set later via file('name'). Does NOT detect chainId-fork handling, nonce replay, or signature malleability.

fp_controls.two_signal_required: S1 (domain separator cached in ctor from name/version) AND S2 (name/version mutable post-ctor) — a separator recomputed live on every call, or a name fixed in the ctor with no setter, does not fire.
fp_controls.name_in_ctor_suppression: name (and version) assigned in the constructor with no post-ctor mutator -> S2 fails -> silent.
fp_controls.live_separator_suppression: no cached/immutable separator (computed on each DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() call) -> S1 fails -> silent.
